subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Workspace Skill Loading: Add Frontmatter Parsing Error Visibility and Validation for SKILL.md

question: Should malformed workspace skill diagnostics be accepted as a `skills lint` validation surface first, or must this issue remain open until normal `skills list`, `skills check`, `skills.status`, and Web UI also show failed SKILL.md candidates?
rationale: Current main still silently drops failures, while the open candidate PR adds a plausible lint command but does not fully settle the broader visibility scope requested here.

options.title: Accept lint-first scope
options.body: Fix the remaining PR parity issue, land `skills lint`, and track normal status/Web diagnostics separately if maintainers still want them.

options.title: Require full visibility now
options.body: Keep the issue blocked on a broader implementation that threads failed-candidate diagnostics through status, list/check, and Web surfaces before calling it solved.

options.title: Pause candidate PR
options.body: Pause the open implementation until maintainers decide the permanent diagnostics surface and path-redaction policy.

recommendation.title: Accept lint-first scope
recommendation.body: Fix the remaining PR parity issue, land `skills lint`, and track normal status/Web diagnostics separately if maintainers still want them.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent blame and skills-loading history make this the strongest available routing candidate for the loader/status scope choice.
